episodes.synopsis: A group of children use mechanical puppets at village festivals. But sometimes they use them for mischief. A group of warriors attack his village.
episodes.title: Run!! Homura

episodes.synopsis: After the attack, the children return to their village in search of their mother but find it burned. They know machine people.
episodes.title: Look! This Is a Clockwork Doll

episodes.synopsis: On their way, the brothers encounter a samurai who is holding a member of the machine people prisoner. He with hatred claims clockwork dolls are for war.
episodes.title: Revenge Attack!? Shogunate Heroes Appear

episodes.synopsis: Following the attempted kidnapping of Hiwou's sister by the Machine Men, the fight between their giant Clockwork Dolls is inevitable. They also meet a member of the Wind Gang who opposes the opening of Japan.
episodes.title: Win or Lose! Arashi Versus Hiwou

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Takayama, the brothers are accommodated in the forest house of a kind lady who lost two children and offers to stay with the two younger brothers.
episodes.title: Goodbye? Tetsu and the Wooden Dolls

episodes.synopsis: The brothers have an accident with their vessel Clockwork Doll and need to fix it. A merchant leads them to a blacksmith who is a despotic and unfriendly man.
episodes.title: Our Aim! To the Mountain's Horizon

episodes.synopsis: Hiwou and his brothers arrive in a town and at the inn they find two girls who are looking for their grandfather because their mother has been killed by some mysterious Clockwork Dolls.
episodes.title: Protect Them! The Secret of Hana and Yuki

episodes.synopsis: Winter is coming on the journey of Hiwou and his brothers, now accompanied by the two princesses. But the Wind Gang with their Clockwork Dolls chase them attacking.
episodes.title: Betrayal? Machi Disappears Into the Snowy Mountain

episodes.synopsis: They finally arrive in Takayama, the city famous for its Clockwork puppet artisans. But there is not his father who apparently has fled to make Clockwork Dolls of steam.
episodes.title: Intense Battle! Where Is My Father

episodes.synopsis: Foreigners cannot enter the interior of Japan but an English botanist does. The Wind Gang discovers him and wants to kill him. Hiwou protects him.
episodes.title: A Westerner! Big Commotion at the Snow Inn

episodes.synopsis: The brothers are joined by a group of samurai who are chased by the Wind Gang. They take refuge in a temple where a priest lives who is afraid of clockwork dolls. But in the fight that comes he has to overcome those fears.
episodes.title: But Why? The Man Who Hates Clockwork Dolls

episodes.synopsis: Hiwou and his brothers arrive in Kyoto in search of their father, but they cannot find him. There they discover an intrigue about the lord of the place and that the two princesses are one - and a prince.
episodes.title: Punishment from Heaven! But Who is Right?

episodes.synopsis: In Kyoto the conspiracy of the shogunate continues. The Wind Gang wants to make Steam Clockwork Dolls to attack Hiwou.
episodes.title: Cheater! Swords Flash in Demon World Kyoto

episodes.synopsis: The New Years festival requires performances by Clockwork Dolls. The struggle of the shogunate and the emperor for the opening of the country continues.
episodes.title: That's Huge! The Goblin Sword Sleeps in the Human World
Don't Cry! Hana
Overcome! Crossing the Fierce Current
Meeting! The Start of Sadness
You're Kidding?! The Dream Father Saw
Hiwou in Danger! Mitsurugi's Clockwork Castle
Dear Father! Time for Departure
Winds of War! Bakan Strait
Don't Go, Hana! The Children's Battlefield
Can You Hear It? Homura's Voice
Keep Burning! Father's Clockwork
Dance! It's Our Festival
So Long, Ryoma! To the Town That'll Be Called Tokyo
